credentialSchema.title: Technitium credential profile
credentialSchema.description: AXI Credential Standard v2 profile. Secret values must be references.

discovery.help:
Managed Technitium reads and native writes. Run artium-axi technitium-axi <command> --help for selectors.
Authenticated results are private and single-use. Writes require host Write permission, an exact native grant, preview and exact confirmation.
Login acquisition, explicit create-token acquisition, alternate reconciliation profiles and local configuration are unavailable.

adapterBoundary.nativeWrites: Independent host and native grants; native confirmation and durable host journals.
